summary.text: Holly Jeffreys is the Republican candidate for Texas House of Representatives District 86 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She previously served at-large on the Bushland Independent School District board, taking office in 2013.

paragraphs.text: Holly Jeffreys advanced from the Republican primary for District 86 on March 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists her as a past officeholder on the Bushland Independent School District in an at-large seat, which she assumed in 2013.
